description.value: Cedar Park Chaat House is an Indian restaurant in Abbotsford specializing in traditional chaat alongside a broad menu spanning tandoor breads, biryani, Indo-Chinese dishes, and classic South Asian comfort food. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, seasonal ingredients and recipes described as rooted in a decade of experience with traditional Indian flavours. The restaurant also runs a lunch buffet and full catering service for events of all sizes.

address.value: 2598 Cedar Park Place, Abbotsford, BC V2T 3S5
